ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.40:0.60 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity mottle clusters concentrated on distal lobe regions (approx. coordinates: left distal tip and right distal tip); distinct diagonal linear bands of light-intensity pixels originating from the medial base extending toward the anterior edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 92 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 0.18 within the central fluke bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged variations (irregular peaks and valleys) continuous along the trailing edge from the notch to both distal tips; most extreme amplitude deviations observed at the terminal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trailing edge trajectory on both lobes, exhibiting a sharp tapering toward the distal points with irregular terminal morphology.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white rings (3-12 pixel diameter) clustered on the right distal lobe and sparsely distributed across the medial black regions, consistent with sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical and horizontal linear pixel disruptions (light-grey against dark-grey background) visible in the lower-medial sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular scarring (rosettes) localized on the right lobe; significant irregular tissue erosion/jaggedness at the distal-most tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' transitional mottling pattern between the dark medial pigmentation and the high-intensity distal patches.
